text:
mike: Heads-up: noticed tenant org-999 got a billing spike. Repro shows a streaming toolcall truncated by max_tokens, client retried, and we ended up with a provisional row still open + a later confirmed row for the retry -> double bill.

mike: Logs:
```
2026-03-23T09:12:11Z stream=s-77 toolcall=translate chunk=3 status=truncated provisional_tokens=95
2026-03-23T09:12:12Z client=r-222 retry_of=chunk-3 provisional_tokens=0
2026-03-23T09:12:13Z ledger:confirm request=r-222 tokens=190 origin=retry
```

anya: Do we emit an explicit abort/tombstone when we truncate? I thought truncation should mark provisional as aborted.

mike: In this trace the abort path didn't run because the toolcall error bubbled out before the abort hook flushed. So provisional stayed open.

devin: Classic ordering race: response returned before ledger state was finalized. Two mitigation directions: make abort write synchronous (adds latency) or make confirm idempotent/merge-aware.

sophie: Prefer merge-aware confirms to avoid impacting latency. Confirm writer should attempt to find overlapping provisional ranges for same (client_trace/session) and atomically collapse into one confirmed entry. If overlap found, mark provisional->confirmed and subtract duplicated tokens.

anya: Implementation detail: what keys do we join on? session_id alone is ambiguous across reconnects; client_trace can rotate. We need a stable joiner.\
mike: Proposal: emit x-origin-trace at session creation and include it in all messages for the session. Join on (origin_trace, seq_range). Minimal header, stateless routing.
devin: If we add origin_trace, confirm writer's merge query will need an index on (origin_trace, seq_start) and possibly seq_end. Add composite index before enabling to avoid confirmation latency.
sophie: Also add a quick defense: on confirm write, if we detect any provisional overlap but can't atomically merge (e.g., race), write the confirmed and create a reconciliation ticket/marker so a background job can neutralize duplicates.

anya: For immediate remediation, run targeted reconcile for org-999 and create a billing adjustment. Billing-bot, can you queue that?
billing-bot: queued: org=org-999 reason=provisional_orphans detected=8 estimated_refund=0.0124 USD

devin: Console UX: users see two lines; make timeline view show provisional (orange) and confirmed (green) grouped by origin_trace. Add a small badge "possible duplicate" when provisional and confirm overlap but aren't linked.

mike: Also telemetry: emit provisional_orphan_rate and confirm_merge_failures per-route. Quick SQL to find candidates:
```
SELECT route, count(*) AS orphans
FROM ledger_entries
WHERE type='provisional' AND aborted=false AND confirmed_ref IS NULL AND created_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY orphans DESC;
```

anya: Rollout plan: 1) add origin_trace header in client lib 0.13 behind flag; 2) deploy confirm-merge logic behind FF; 3) create DB index in migration window; 4) run reconcile job; 5) flip FF after canary. Keep fallback behavior if header absent.
devin: We must ensure backwards compatibility: if origin_trace missing, fall back to current behavior. Add logging to capture how many requests lack origin_trace during canary.
sophie: Tests: unit test for confirm-merge; integration sim that truncates mid-KV-evict and retries; e2e billing smoke. Also add a chaos test for broker restarts during confirm to ensure idempotency.

mike: Ops: when enabling the index, be careful about locking; use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY or equivalent. We'll schedule during low traffic.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: confirm-merge-ff -> canary in 40m :gear:

anya: One more edge: client SDKs that buffer and re-send the same chunks after network flaps must include the origin_trace so dedupe works. Add a note to SDK changelog.

mike: I'll open the RFC + console mock + migration plan. Sophie, can you draft the confirm writer patch? Devin, can you handle the DB index PR?
sophie: Yup. I'll add the unit tests and a small benchmark to ensure confirm path latency stays within SLA when merge enabled.
devin: Will do. Scheduling index during 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance window.
mike: Thanks. I'll coordinate the reconcile for org-999 and post updates here. :thumbsup:
